reviewer: Independent Codex vision review (motion/character creative reskin)

projection.note: All twelve poses retain a coherent elevated front view, with top-facing hair/shoulders and consistent light.

complete-art.note: All limbs and hair remain complete inside the frames; no subject is clipped or replaced by the 3D control.

anchor-placement.note: The new boot/heel region falls below the original support center at the same root. The reference/candidate pairs show leg-length/support displacement rather than merely added toe length.

same-player.note: The same brown-haired adventurer, blue tunic, belt and brown boots persists; facial expression and arm gestures change consistently.

dancing-poses.note: Twelve complete upper-body dance gestures with distinct elbow/fist and head positions are readable, with no missing/fused limbs.

design-height.note: Compared at unchanged roots, the refined legs and boots lengthen the standing body. This is a nominal anatomy-scale change, not a raised-arm silhouette or a crouch.

contact-stability.note: Soles/support move upward between sheet rows and through the final-to-first transition. The native frame00/frame11 pair shows an unintended vertical foot shift while metadata roots remain fixed.

cutout-quality.note: Clean light/dark edges retain complete shoes, with no colored floor residue or holes in the usable sprites.

loop.note: Actual 12fps playback visits all12 frames and wraps, but the final pose returns to frame1 with an unintended support/vertical-placement step. Playback validity does not make that transition seamless.

source-faithfulness.note: Fixed-panel extraction preserves the original reskin, including the expanded legs and row-dependent placement. No per-frame fitting, floor key or renderer-alpha stencil is used.
